title: Deep Learning-Assisted SERS of Fine-Needle Aspiration Washout Fluid for Preoperative Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma Diagnosis and Lymph Node Metastasis Prediction.
summary: Deep-learning classification of SERS spectra from thyroid fine-needle aspiration washout fluid predicted papillary thyroid carcinoma and lymph-node metastasis against held-out labels in a retrospective cohort.
ai_technology: Mendelian randomization, machine learning and expression analysis
organization: China-Japan Union Hospital of Jilin University

evidence.tested: The held-out diagnostic and nodal-prediction results were evaluated within the study cohort; external validation and clinical benefit remain unestablished.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Mendelian randomization, machine learning and expression analysis enabled the stated case-specific result.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
